verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party conversational assistant that chases missing receipts, explains declines, or answers pre-spend "can I expense this?" questions. Clara MCP lets an external AI assistant list cards, review transactions, or lock cards in natural language, but that is a developer building block, not the policy-enforcement assistant itself. Clara Intelligence is described only as spend insights and a "CFO agent" for budget forecasting, with nothing about employee-facing policy conversations.
